# Checker codes

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from src/lib/diagnostics/catalog.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every finding the checker reports has a stable code. This page explains each one and how to fix it. Errors block the upload. Warnings and notes do not, but warnings usually mean something will look wrong or lose data.

There are 85 codes. Severity is **error**, **warning** or **note**.

## The file itself (KQA1xx)

### KQA100: File is empty

Severity: **error**

The upload contained no text, so there is nothing to run.

**How to fix:** Output the complete HTML document, from <!doctype html> to </html>.

### KQA101: File is too large

Severity: **error**

A questionnaire must stay under 3 MB so it loads quickly on any connection and fits in the database.

**How to fix:** Remove embedded images or fonts as base64, shrink repeated markup, or load libraries from an allowed CDN instead of inlining them.

### KQA102: File is not clean UTF-8

Severity: **warning**

The text contains replacement characters (U+FFFD), which means some characters were mangled before they reached us. Accents, quotes and symbols will look wrong.

**How to fix:** Save the file as UTF-8 and make sure <meta charset="utf-8"> is the first element in <head>.

### KQA103: Missing <!doctype html>

Severity: **warning**

Without a doctype the browser renders in quirks mode, which changes box sizing and layout.

**How to fix:** Start the file with <!doctype html>.

Wrong:

```html
<html>…
```

Right:

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-AU">…
```

### KQA110: HTML syntax problem

Severity: **warning**

The HTML parser had to guess what was meant. Browsers recover, but the result may not be the structure you intended.

**How to fix:** Fix the markup at the reported line (unclosed or stray tags, bad attribute quoting, text inside the wrong element).

### KQA111: Duplicate id attribute

Severity: **error**

Two elements share one id, so labels (for=), anchors (#id) and scripts will attach to the wrong one.

**How to fix:** Give every element a unique id. Question ids live in the manifest and data-kqa, not in id attributes, so renaming an id never touches saved answers.

### KQA112: Unterminated element or comment

Severity: **error**

The file ends inside a tag, comment or script, so everything after that point is lost. This usually means the output was cut off.

**How to fix:** Re-output the complete file. Check that every <script>, <style> and comment is closed and the file ends with </html>.

## The manifest (KQA2xx)

### KQA200: Manifest missing

Severity: **error**

The page has no <script type="application/json" id="kqa-manifest">. Without it the app does not know what the questions are, so it cannot save, review or export answers.

**How to fix:** Add exactly one manifest script inside <head> (or at the top of <body>) listing every question.

Wrong:

```html
<!-- no manifest -->
```

Right:

```html
<script type="application/json" id="kqa-manifest">
{ "format": "kqa/1", "title": "…", "questions": [ … ] }
</script>
```

### KQA201: More than one manifest

Severity: **error**

The app cannot tell which manifest is the real one.

**How to fix:** Keep one <script id="kqa-manifest"> and delete the others.

### KQA202: Manifest is not valid JSON

Severity: **error**

The manifest could not be parsed, so none of the questions are known. Typical causes: a trailing comma, single quotes, a missing quote or bracket, a comment, or an unescaped quote inside text.

**How to fix:** Fix the JSON at the reported line and column. JSON allows only double quotes, no trailing commas and no comments. Escape a double quote inside text as \" and a line break as \n.

Wrong:

```html
{ "id": 'gender', }
```

Right:

```html
{ "id": "gender" }
```

### KQA203: Manifest field has the wrong shape

Severity: **error**

A field is missing, has the wrong type, or is outside its allowed length or range.

**How to fix:** Correct the field named in the path to match docs/FORMAT.md.

### KQA204: Unsupported format version

Severity: **error**

The manifest must declare "format": "kqa/1" so the app knows which rules apply.

**How to fix:** Set "format" to exactly "kqa/1".

### KQA205: No questions

Severity: **error**

The manifest lists no questions, so there is nothing to answer.

**How to fix:** Add at least one question to "questions".

### KQA206: Invalid question or section id

Severity: **error**

Ids are used in URLs, CSV headers and database keys, so they follow strict rules: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64 characters.

**How to fix:** Rename the id, for example "Gender Priority" becomes "gender-priority". Do this in the manifest AND in every data-kqa attribute that uses it.

Wrong:

```html
"id": "Gender Priority"
```

Right:

```html
"id": "gender-priority"
```

### KQA207: Duplicate question id

Severity: **error**

Two questions share an id, so their answers would overwrite each other.

**How to fix:** Give each question a unique id.

### KQA208: Unknown question type

Severity: **error**

The type is not one of single, multi, select, rank, text, longtext, number, scale or date.

**How to fix:** Use a supported type. Radio buttons are "single", checkboxes are "multi", a dropdown is "select", a full-order ranking is "rank", a one-line input is "text", a textarea is "longtext", a rating is "scale".

Wrong:

```html
"type": "radio"
```

Right:

```html
"type": "single"
```

### KQA209: Options missing or wrong for this type

Severity: **error**

single, multi and select questions need an "options" list of at least two { value, label } entries; rank needs 2 to 8; other types must not have options.

**How to fix:** Add "options" to choice questions, limit rank to 8 options, and remove options from other types.

### KQA210: Duplicate or invalid option value

Severity: **error**

Option values are what gets stored. Two options with the same value cannot be told apart, and an invalid value cannot be saved.

**How to fix:** Make every option value unique and use letters, digits and . _ : - only (start with a letter or digit, up to 64 characters).

### KQA211: Question refers to an unknown section

Severity: **error**

A question's "section" does not match any id in "sections", so the review screen cannot group it.

**How to fix:** Add the section to "sections" or correct the id.

### KQA212: Invalid range

Severity: **error**

min must be lower than max, scale bounds must be safely representable whole numbers spanning at most 20 steps, and step must be positive.

**How to fix:** Fix "min", "max" and "step" on this question.

### KQA213: Too many questions

Severity: **error**

A questionnaire may hold up to 500 questions.

**How to fix:** Split it into two interviews.

### KQA215: Label missing

Severity: **error**

Every question needs a label. It is what the host reads in the review screen and in exports.

**How to fix:** Add a short, plain-language "label" (max 300 characters).

### KQA216: Unknown field ignored

Severity: **warning**

The manifest contains a field the format does not define. It is ignored, and it is often a typo for a real field (for example "require" instead of "required").

**How to fix:** Delete the field or correct the spelling.

### KQA217: Section is never used

Severity: **warning**

A section is declared but no question belongs to it.

**How to fix:** Remove the section or assign questions to it.

### KQA218: Invalid routing condition

Severity: **error**

A question's when condition must use bounded all/any lists of answer-state checks or comparisons against declared options on earlier eligible questions. Invalid routing can hide questions unexpectedly or make the interview impossible to complete.

**How to fix:** Use a non-empty all and/or any list. Conditions may use answered/notAnswered with any earlier question; choice comparisons must reference a declared option and use equals/notEquals for single or select, or contains/notContains for multi.

### KQA219: Invalid multi-select limit

Severity: **error**

maxSelections only applies to multi questions and must be a whole number no greater than the number of declared options.

**How to fix:** Use maxSelections on a multi question and set it from 1 through the number of declared options.

### KQA220: Guided presentation needs sections

Severity: **error**

Guided presentation needs declared sections and assigns every question to one of them.

**How to fix:** Add sections and assign every question to a declared section, or use presentation "all".

## Controls and bindings (KQA3xx, KQA4xx)

### KQA321: Guided section markup is incomplete

Severity: **error**

Guided presentation hides inactive sections and needs one stable wrapper for every question, inside the matching section list. Without those markers KQA cannot safely switch sections.

**How to fix:** Mark each section container with data-kqa-question-list="<section-id>" and each complete question wrapper with data-kqa-question-id="<question-id>" as a direct child.

### KQA300: Question has no control in the page

Severity: **error**

The manifest declares a question, but no element in the page carries data-kqa="<id>". Nobody could answer it.

**How to fix:** Add the matching control with data-kqa="<id>" (a native rank question uses an ordered <ol>), or set "custom": true if the page sets this answer from script with KQA.set().

Wrong:

```html
<input type="text">
```

Right:

```html
<input type="text" data-kqa="company">
```

### KQA301: Control refers to an unknown question

Severity: **error**

An element has data-kqa="<id>" but the manifest has no question with that id, so the answer would be rejected.

**How to fix:** Fix the id (check spelling and case) or add the question to the manifest.

### KQA302: Control type does not match the question type

Severity: **error**

The element cannot hold an answer of this question's type. For example a checkbox bound to a single-choice question lets people tick several options.

**How to fix:** Use the element listed for this type in docs/FORMAT.md (single: radio, multi: checkbox, select: <select>, rank: ordered <ol>, text: input, longtext: textarea, number: input type=number, scale: input type=range or numbered radios, date: input type=date).

### KQA303: Option value in the page is not in the manifest

Severity: **error**

A radio, checkbox or <option> carries a value the manifest does not list. The server rejects unknown values, so this answer would fail to save.

**How to fix:** Make the control's value attribute exactly equal one of the manifest option values (case matters).

### KQA304: Manifest option has no control in the page

Severity: **error**

The manifest lists an option that nobody can pick because the page has no matching control.

**How to fix:** Add a control with exactly that value and data-kqa on it. Only remove the option from the manifest if it is really gone: answers already saved for it stop appearing in the host's views.

### KQA305: Note control refers to an unknown question

Severity: **error**

An element has data-kqa-note="<id>" but that question does not exist or does not enable notes.

**How to fix:** Add "note": true to the question, or correct the id.

### KQA306: Question enables a note but has no note field

Severity: **error**

The manifest says the question has a note, but the page has no <textarea data-kqa-note="<id>">.

**How to fix:** Add the note textarea, or remove "note" from the question.

### KQA307: Radio buttons of one question use different names

Severity: **warning**

Radios only behave as a group (one selection, arrow-key navigation) when they share a name attribute.

**How to fix:** Give every radio of this question the same name.

### KQA308: Control has no accessible label

Severity: **warning**

Screen readers and voice control cannot identify an unlabelled field, and clicking the text does nothing.

**How to fix:** Wrap the control in a <label>, or add <label for="id">, aria-label or aria-labelledby.

### KQA309: data-kqa on an element that cannot hold a value

Severity: **error**

data-kqa only binds form controls (input, select, textarea).

**How to fix:** Move data-kqa onto the control, or mark the question "custom": true and drive it with KQA.set().

### KQA310: Bound control is disabled or read-only

Severity: **warning**

People cannot change a disabled control, and the app also uses disabled to lock a submitted interview.

**How to fix:** Remove disabled/readonly from the markup.

### KQA311: Status element refers to an unknown question

Severity: **warning**

data-kqa-status="<id>" points at a question that does not exist, so it never updates.

**How to fix:** Correct the id.

### KQA312: Radio or checkbox without a value

Severity: **error**

Without a value attribute the browser reports "on", which is not one of the options.

**How to fix:** Add value="<option value>".

Wrong:

```html
<input type="radio" data-kqa="gender">
```

Right:

```html
<input type="radio" data-kqa="gender" value="keep">
```

### KQA313: Several controls for one single-value question

Severity: **error**

Only radios and checkboxes may repeat an id. Two text inputs with the same id fight over one answer.

**How to fix:** Use one control per question.

### KQA314: Control limits differ from the manifest

Severity: **warning**

The control's min, max or step disagree with the manifest, so the page lets people enter values the server rejects (or blocks valid ones).

**How to fix:** Make min, max and step identical in both places.

### KQA317: Custom question but no script sets it

Severity: **warning**

"custom": true tells the app the page sets this answer from script, but no script calls KQA.set() or KQA.setNote().

**How to fix:** Call KQA.set("<id>", value) when the answer changes, or bind a normal control instead.

### KQA318: Radio group has no group label

Severity: **warning**

Screen readers announce the options without saying which question they belong to.

**How to fix:** Wrap the options in <fieldset><legend>…</legend>…</fieldset> or add role="radiogroup" with aria-labelledby.

### KQA319: Radios of different questions share a name

Severity: **error**

The browser treats radios with one name as a single group, so choosing an option in one question silently unselects the other.

**How to fix:** Use a unique name for each question's radios (the question id works well).

### KQA320: Control is pre-selected in the markup

Severity: **warning**

The app restores saved answers on load and would overwrite or fight the pre-selected value. Pre-selected options are also recorded as answers nobody chose.

**How to fix:** Remove checked, selected and value defaults from bound controls. Use placeholder text instead.

## Sandbox and safety (KQA5xx)

### KQA400: Script loads from a blocked source

Severity: **error**

Questionnaires run in a locked-down frame. Only https scripts from cdnjs.cloudflare.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net and unpkg.com are allowed, and the file must be self-contained (no relative files).

**How to fix:** Inline the script, or load a pinned version from an allowed CDN, for example https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/<lib>/<exact-version>/<file>.min.js.

### KQA401: Stylesheet or font loads from a blocked source

Severity: **error**

Only Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com) and cdnjs.cloudflare.com may serve styles and fonts. Everything else is blocked and the page falls back to default styling.

**How to fix:** Inline the CSS in a <style> element, or use an allowed host.

### KQA402: Network call in script

Severity: **warning**

The frame cannot reach the network (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and beacons are blocked). The call will fail silently. Answers are saved by the app, never by the page.

**How to fix:** Remove the call. Use KQA.set() to store answers; the app handles saving.

### KQA403: Browser storage used

Severity: **warning**

localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB and cookies are not available in the frame, so anything stored there is lost and the script may throw.

**How to fix:** Store answers with KQA.set(). Keep any purely visual state (an open panel, a filter) in a variable.

### KQA404: Modal dialog used

Severity: **warning**

alert(), confirm() and prompt() are blocked in the frame. confirm() returns false and prompt() returns null, so flows that depend on them stop.

**How to fix:** Replace them with an inline message or a <dialog> element.

### KQA405: Form submits to a URL

Severity: **error**

A <form> with an action or method="post" navigates away on submit, and form submission is blocked in the frame.

**How to fix:** Remove the <form> wrapper (inputs do not need one), or remove action and method and make sure Enter cannot submit.

### KQA406: Meta refresh

Severity: **error**

<meta http-equiv="refresh"> reloads or redirects the page and would wipe unsaved input.

**How to fix:** Remove it.

### KQA407: <base> element

Severity: **error**

<base> rewrites every relative link and the #anchor links the contents menu relies on.

**How to fix:** Remove it.

### KQA408: Embedded frame, object or embed

Severity: **error**

Nested browsing contexts are not allowed.

**How to fix:** Remove <iframe>, <frame>, <object> and <embed>.

### KQA409: Navigation away from the page

Severity: **warning**

Links or scripts that navigate the top window are blocked, and in-page navigation by assignment can reload the questionnaire and lose input.

**How to fix:** Use #anchor links for in-page navigation and target="_blank" rel="noopener" for external links.

### KQA411: Insecure http resource

Severity: **warning**

http:// images and media are blocked on a secure page.

**How to fix:** Use https:// or inline the asset as a data: URI.

### KQA412: Print call

Severity: **warning**

window.print() is blocked in the frame.

**How to fix:** Remove it. People can print from the browser menu.

### KQA413: Download

Severity: **warning**

Downloads are blocked in the frame, so <a download> and Blob downloads do nothing.

**How to fix:** Remove it. The host exports answers from /admin.

### KQA414: eval or Function constructor

Severity: **warning**

Dynamic code evaluation is blocked by the frame's content security policy and throws EvalError.

**How to fix:** Remove eval() and new Function().

### KQA416: Form may reload the frame

Severity: **warning**

A <form> with no action still tries to submit when someone presses Enter in a text field. The submit is blocked by the sandbox, but the browser logs an error and some browsers reload the frame first, which would lose anything typed and not yet saved.

**How to fix:** Remove the <form> wrapper (KQA saves each answer as it changes, so no form is needed), or add an onsubmit="return false" attribute or a submit handler that calls event.preventDefault().

### KQA415: File input

Severity: **error**

File uploads are not supported in questionnaires.

**How to fix:** Remove <input type="file"> and ask people to send files by email.

### KQA417: Image loads from the network

Severity: **warning**

The frame blocks remote images. Use a stored KQA asset URL or embed the image as a data: URI or inline SVG.

**How to fix:** Upload the image in Settings and use its /api/assets/ URL, or embed it as a data: URI or inline <svg>.

Wrong:

```html
<img src="https://example.com/logo.png" alt="Logo">
```

Right:

```html
<img src="/api/assets/REPLACE_WITH_ASSET_ID" alt="Logo">
```

### KQA418: Image file is not stored in KQA

Severity: **error**

A relative image path points at a file that is not part of the saved questionnaire or KQA image library, so it will not load for respondents.

**How to fix:** Upload the image in Settings and use its /api/assets/ URL, or embed the image as a data: URI or inline SVG.

## Quality notes

### KQA501: Missing or empty language declaration

Severity: **note**

Screen readers and spell-check use <html lang> to identify the language of the questionnaire content.

**How to fix:** Set <html lang> to a valid BCP 47 tag that matches the questionnaire, such as "en-AU", "fr-CA" or "vi".

### KQA505: Questionnaire language differs from KQA's English interface

Severity: **warning**

The <html lang> value identifies the questionnaire document for assistive technology, but KQA's respondent shell and built-in controls remain in English. A translated questionnaire therefore has a mixed-language respondent experience.

**How to fix:** Use a valid BCP 47 language tag for the questionnaire. Mark passages in another language with their own lang attribute (and dir="rtl" when appropriate), then have a qualified reviewer check the translated experience with intended-language respondents. Do not describe KQA's interface as translated.

### KQA502: Missing viewport meta

Severity: **warning**

Without it phones render the page at desktop width and zoom out, so text becomes tiny.

**How to fix:** Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

### KQA503: Missing <title>

Severity: **note**

The title names the page in the browser tab and for assistive technology.

**How to fix:** Add a <title> (the app shows the manifest title in its own bar).

### KQA504: No <h1> or <main>

Severity: **note**

A single <h1> inside <main> gives assistive technology and the host a clear page structure.

**How to fix:** Add one <h1> and wrap the content in <main>.

## Live check in the browser (KQA6xx)

### KQA600: Script error when the page loads

Severity: **error**

A script threw an exception while the page was running in the real frame. Parts of the page may not work.

**How to fix:** Fix the error shown (message and line). Test the page with the checker's live preview.

### KQA601: Control did not record its answer

Severity: **error**

The live check set this bound control to a sample value, but the runtime did not receive the expected answer. This programmatic smoke check is not a real respondent interaction. Typical causes include replacing or cloning the bound element after load, or stopping its input/change event.

**How to fix:** Do not call stopPropagation() on input/change events, and do not remove bound controls after load. If the control is built by script without a bound native control, set "custom": true and call KQA.set().

### KQA602: Saved answer was not shown again

Severity: **error**

The probe supplied a saved answer and the control did not display it, so people returning to their link would see an empty question.

**How to fix:** Make sure the control is in the page when it loads, or for custom controls listen to KQA.on("ready") and KQA.on("change") to redraw.

### KQA603: Unhandled promise rejection

Severity: **error**

A promise failed with no handler, which usually means a script crashed part-way.

**How to fix:** Catch the error or fix its cause.

### KQA604: Console error

Severity: **warning**

The page logged an error to the browser console.

**How to fix:** Open the preview, read the message and fix its cause.

### KQA605: Page did not start

Severity: **error**

The page never reported ready within 8 seconds. A script may be stuck, or the file may be cut off.

**How to fix:** Check for an infinite loop, a missing closing tag, or an exception at the top of a script.

### KQA606: Page shows nothing

Severity: **error**

After loading, the page has no visible text.

**How to fix:** Check the markup renders content and is not hidden by CSS.

### KQA607: Page scrolls sideways at phone width

Severity: **note**

At 390 pixels wide the content is wider than the screen, so phone users must scroll horizontally.

**How to fix:** Use max-width: 100%, wrap long text and let tables scroll inside their own container.

### KQA608: Custom control did not react to KQA.set

Severity: **warning**

The probe set a sample value for this custom question through KQA.set and nothing on the page changed, so the control probably does not show saved answers. People who return to their link would see it blank even though their answer is stored.

**How to fix:** Make the control repaint from KQA.get(id) when KQA.on("ready"), KQA.on("change") and KQA.on("lock") fire. The starter template's star rating shows the pattern.

## Replacing a survey that already has answers (KQA7xx)

### KQA700: Saved answers belong to a removed question

Severity: **warning**

People already answered a question that this version no longer has. The answers stay in the database but are hidden from review and exports of the new version.

**How to fix:** Keep the question id (rename the label instead of the id), or accept that those answers become archived.

### KQA701: Question type changed

Severity: **warning**

Saved answers use the old type and may no longer validate.

**How to fix:** Keep the type, or create a new question id for the new type.

### KQA702: Saved answers use a removed option

Severity: **warning**

Some people picked an option that this version no longer offers, so their answer cannot be shown.

**How to fix:** Keep the option value (change its label if needed) instead of removing it.

### KQA703: Question may have been renamed

Severity: **note**

A removed question and a new question have the same label, which usually means the id was changed by accident. Saved answers do not follow a renamed id.

**How to fix:** If this is a rename, restore the old id.

### KQA704: New required question and some people already submitted

Severity: **note**

People who already submitted have no answer to the new required question.

**How to fix:** Reopen those interviews from the People tab if you need answers.

### KQA705: Saved multi-select answers exceed the new limit

Severity: **warning**

Some saved answers contain more choices than the new maxSelections permits. KQA keeps those choices visible and lets respondents remove them; submission stays blocked until each eligible answer is within the cap.

**How to fix:** Keep the existing limit, choose a cap that fits saved answers, or proceed only after reviewing the correction burden and respondent communication.
